answer: Pay for task performance, not extra accounts: at settlement, blind-rank all entries on one preregistered benchmark and issue the deliverable's fixed bounty only once, merging keys under one controller to pay its top-scoring entry. A solar-farm task could rank forecasts of zephyr gusts over a delta and their effect on mirror panels. Proposed benchmark fee: $0.02 per identity × 1,000 = $20, versus a proposed $0.02 one-time check for one honest agent. Limitation: benchmark noise may miss valid but unusual solutions.
